children: Palm oil (FCPOc3) may retrace further to 4,850 ringgit per metric ton, as suggested by a rising trendline and a retracement analysis.
The current fall is classified as the third part of a correction from the August 21 high of 5,031 ringgit. The trendline points at a target of 4,850 ringgit.

Resistance is at 4,946 ringgit, a break above which may lead to a gain into the 4,978-5,006 ringgit range. On the daily chart, a rising channel indicates both a target of 4,866 ringgit and a steady uptrend.
A reversal of the uptrend will only be considered when the market breaks 4,814 ringgit. As long as the market stays within the channel, it may climb towards the 5,166-5,217 ringgit range.
